item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed an investigation by Western Power into allegations that an employee falsified power pole inspection records.
item.support: The Commission conducted a review of Western Power's investigation.

item.text: The Commission considered the investigation thorough and accepted that Western Power's conclusions were supported by the available evidence.
item.support: The conclusions reached by Western Power were open to be made based on the evidence available.

item.text: The Commission considered notification of suspected misconduct late and disagreed with the decision against reporting the conduct to police.
item.support: The Commission has concerns with the decision by Western Power not to report the employee's conduct to the WA Police Force.

item.text: The Commission made no formal recommendations, recognising the investigation and changes to auditing intended to detect similar conduct.
item.support: In view of Western Power's investigation, the Commission makes no formal recommendations.
